title: THC Advanced Nutrition, Diagnostics and Plant Health Certificate
publicDescription: Demonstrates applied capability in nutrient and root-zone differential diagnosis, IPM trend interpretation, evidence weighting, measurement verification, corrective-action boundaries, and escalation.
limitations: This Academy credential is educational and employment-oriented; it is not a government cannabis license or occupational license.
It does not authorize pesticide application, restricted chemical use, medical diagnosis, or product-disposition decisions beyond workplace authorization and applicable law.
